; Notebook assistant panel. Document-view insertion target for firmware 3.27.
; Requires XOVI qt-resource-rebuilder with a hashtable for the current firmware.
AFFECT [[17298303916558156758]]
    TRAVERSE [[254504370080162629]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: assistantPanelLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 1000000
                source: "file:///home/root/smart-remarkable/Settings.qml"
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Add controls to the native toolbar layout after the writing tools. The
; layout's existing spacer absorbs their height, preserving bottom controls.
AFFECT [[11313888899523275277]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]] > [[6502786168]][.[[5972374]]=[[233745975898428]]] > [[8398044571386570029]]
        LOCATE BEFORE Item
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: assistantSettingsLoader
                Layout.preferredWidth: root.minSize.width
                Layout.preferredHeight: root.minSize.height
                visible: root.expanded
                source: "file:///home/root/smart-remarkable/AssistantButton.qml"
                Connections { target: assistantSettingsLoader.item; function onActivated() { root.closeFoldout() } }
                PenInputBlocker { anchors.fill: parent; enabled: parent.visible; manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager }
            }
            Loader {
                id: assistantSendLoader
                Layout.preferredWidth: root.minSize.width
                Layout.preferredHeight: root.minSize.height
                visible: root.expanded
                source: "file:///home/root/smart-remarkable/AssistantButton.qml"
                onLoaded: item.sendSelection = true
                Connections { target: assistantSendLoader.item; function onActivated() { root.closeFoldout() } }
                PenInputBlocker { anchors.fill: parent; enabled: parent.visible; manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
